The question asks for the last competition, meaning the most recent date in the table.  

Looking at the Date column:  
- The earliest is 31 October 2008.  
- Then 1 November 2008, 2 November 2008, 13 February 2009, 30 October 2009, 1 November 2009.  
- The latest date is 1 November 2009.  

On 1 November 2009, the competition listed is "2009–10 World Cup".  

Thus, the last competition date is 1 November 2009.  

Final Answer: 1 November 2009
